OK here's the spec:

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true
require "spec_helper"
require "samagotchi/session_metrics"
require "samagotchi/token_usage"

RSpec.describe "reasoning clock" do
  let(:monotonic) { [100.0] }
  let(:metrics) { Samagotchi::SessionMetrics.new(clock: -> { monotonic[0] }) }
  def tick(s) = monotonic[0] += s

  it "counts the estimate from the first reasoning chunk" do
    metrics.call(type: :turn_started, session_id: "s", prompt: "p", turn_id: "t")
    metrics.call(type: :generation_started, iteration: 1)
    tick(2.0)
    # chat loop shape: content = reasoning + content
    metrics.call(type: :generation_chunk, iteration: 1, content: "thinking", text: "", thinking: "thinking",
                 payload: { "choices" => [{ "delta" => { "reasoning" => "thinking" } }] })
    tick(3.0)
    metrics.call(type: :generation_chunk, iteration: 1, content: "answer", text: "answer", thinking: "",
                 payload: { "choices" => [{ "delta" => { "content" => "answer" } }] })
    tick(1.0)
    metrics.call(type: :generation_chunk, iteration: 1, content: "", text: "", thinking: "",
                 payload: { "choices" => [], "usage" => { "prompt_tokens" => 100, "completion_tokens" => 400,
                                                          "completion_tokens_details" => { "reasoning_tokens" => 300 } } })
    metrics.call(type: :generation_completed, iteration: 1)
    # 400 tokens over 4s from the first reasoning chunk = 100 tok/s
    expect(metrics.snapshot[:tokens]).to include(last_decode_tps: 100.0, tps_source: "estimate")
  end
end
```
